{"actor_id":"EO:13304","char_end":3886,"char_start":3762,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"agency_variable","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3320,"char_start":2832,"text":"Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622), termination \nof the national emergencies declared in Executive Order 12808 of May \n30, 1992, and Executive Order 13088 of June 9, 1998, shall not affect any \naction taken or proceeding pending not finally concluded or determined \nas of the effective date of this order, or any action or proceeding based \non any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties that \nmatured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."},{"char_end":3752,"char_start":3321,"text":"Pursuant to \nsection 207 of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706), I hereby determine that the continu-\nation of prohibitions with regard to transactions involving any property \nblocked pursuant to Executive Orders 12808 or 13088 that continues to \nbe blocked as of the effective date of this order is necessary on account \nof claims involving successor states to the former Socialist Federal Republic \nof Yugoslavia or other potential claimants."},{"char_end":6722,"char_start":3994,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), and the Trade Sanctions \nReform and Export Enhancement Act of 2000 (Title IX, Public Law 106–\nVerDate Jan<31>2003 15:49 May 28, 2003 Jkt 200001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\29MYE0.SGM 29MYE0\n=== PDF page 2 of 8 ===\n32316 Federal Register / Vol. 68, No. 103 / Thursday, May 29, 2003 / Presidential Documents \n387), and in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may hereafter \nbe issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered \ninto or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this \norder, all property and interests in property of: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(ii) persons designated by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, because they are determined: \n(A) to be under open indictment by the International Criminal Tribunal \nfor the former Yugoslavia, unless circumstances warrant otherwise, or \n(B) to have committed, or to pose a significant risk of committing, acts \nof violence that have the purpose or effect of threatening the peace in \nor diminishing the stability or security of any area or state in the Western \nBalkans region, undermining the authority, efforts, or objectives of inter-\nnational organizations or entities present in the region, or endangering the \nsafety of persons participating in or providing support to the activities \nof those international organizations or entities, or \n(C) to have actively obstructed, or pose a significant risk of actively ob-\nstructing, the Ohrid Framework Agreement of 2001 relating to Macedonia, \nUnited Nations Security Council Resolution 1244 relating to Kosovo, or \nthe Dayton Accords or the Conclusions of the Peace Implementation Con-\nference held in London on December 8 –9, 1995, including the decisions \nor conclusions of the High Representative, the Peace Implementation Council \nor its Steering Board, relating to Bosnia and Herzegovina, or \n(D) to have materially assisted in, sponsored, or provided financial, mate-\nrial, or technological support for, or goods or services in support of, such \nacts of violence or obstructionism or any person listed in or designated \npursuant to this order, or \n(E) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act directly \nor indirectly for or on behalf of, any person listed in or designated pursuant \nto this order, that are or hereafter come within the United States, or that \nare or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States \npersons, are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, \nor otherwise dealt in."},{"char_end":7829,"char_start":7615,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures \nto be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in this order, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto this order."},{"char_end":8275,"char_start":8179,"text":"Such a determination \nshall become effective upon publication in the Federal Register.’’\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9580,"char_start":9503,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May \n29, - **ACT:EO:13219>EO:13304@a07d6950eba9838c**; Sdcca9a0161c31b98d5c9d8a9; {"actor_id":"EO:13304","char_end":3950,"char_start":3826,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"agency_variable","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3384,"char_start":2896,"text":"Pursuant to section 202 of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622), termination \nof the national emergencies declared in Executive Order 12808 of May \n30, 1992, and Executive Order 13088 of June 9, 1998, shall not affect any \naction taken or proceeding pending not finally concluded or determined \nas of the effective date of this order, or any action or proceeding based \non any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties that \nmatured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."},{"char_end":3816,"char_start":3385,"text":"Pursuant to \nsection 207 of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706), I hereby determine that the continu-\nation of prohibitions with regard to transactions involving any property \nblocked pursuant to Executive Orders 12808 or 13088 that continues to \nbe blocked as of the effective date of this order is necessary on account \nof claims involving successor states to the former Socialist Federal Republic \nof Yugoslavia or other potential claimants."},{"char_end":6786,"char_start":4058,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), and the Trade Sanctions \nReform and Export Enhancement Act of 2000 (Title IX, Public Law 106–\nVerDate Jan<31>2003 15:49 May 28, 2003 Jkt 200001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4705 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\29MYE0.SGM 29MYE0\n=== PDF page 2 of 8 ===\n32316 Federal Register / Vol. 68, No. 103 / Thursday, May 29, 2003 / Presidential Documents \n387), and in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may hereafter \nbe issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered \ninto or any license or permit granted prior to the effective date of this \norder, all property and interests in property of: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; and \n(ii) persons designated by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, because they are determined: \n(A) to be under open indictment by the International Criminal Tribunal \nfor the former Yugoslavia, unless circumstances warrant otherwise, or \n(B) to have committed, or to pose a significant risk of committing, acts \nof violence that have the purpose or effect of threatening the peace in \nor diminishing the stability or security of any area or state in the Western \nBalkans region, undermining the authority, efforts, or objectives of inter-\nnational organizations or entities present in the region, or endangering the \nsafety of persons participating in or providing support to the activities \nof those international organizations or entities, or \n(C) to have actively obstructed, or pose a significant risk of actively ob-\nstructing, the Ohrid Framework Agreement of 2001 relating to Macedonia, \nUnited Nations Security Council Resolution 1244 relating to Kosovo, or \nthe Dayton Accords or the Conclusions of the Peace Implementation Con-\nference held in London on December 8 –9, 1995, including the decisions \nor conclusions of the High Representative, the Peace Implementation Council \nor its Steering Board, relating to Bosnia and Herzegovina, or \n(D) to have materially assisted in, sponsored, or provided financial, mate-\nrial, or technological support for, or goods or services in support of, such \nacts of violence or obstructionism or any person listed in or designated \npursuant to this order, or \n(E) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act directly \nor indirectly for or on behalf of, any person listed in or designated pursuant \nto this order, that are or hereafter come within the United States, or that \nare or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States \npersons, are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, \nor otherwise dealt in."},{"char_end":7893,"char_start":7679,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures \nto be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in this order, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto this order."},{"char_end":8339,"char_start":8243,"text":"Such a determination \nshall become effective upon publication in the Federal Register.’’\nSec. 5."},{"char_end":9644,"char_start":9567,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May \n29, 2003."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13219>EO:13304@a07d6950eba9838c","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted.   Text: [Tbfb7f1050ecf1154d0dc3f0a](#tbfb7f1050ecf1154d0dc3f0a); absolute characters 3158–3282
- **ACT:EO:13219>EO:14033**; Sddd4a78b7d80a5af0fcd66fe; {"actor_id":"EO:14033","char_end":10019,"char_start":9353,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2318,"char_start":1212,"text":"BIDEN JR., President of the United States of America, hereby \nexpand the scope of the national emergency declared in Executive Order \n13219 of June 26, 2001 (Blocking Property of Persons Who Threaten Inter-\nnational Stabilization Efforts in the Western Balkans), as amended by Execu-\ntive Order 13304 of May 28, 2003 (Termination of Emergencies With Respect \nto Yugoslavia and Modification of Executive Order 13219 of June 26, 2001), \nfinding that the situation in the territory of the former Socialist Federal \nRepublic of Yugoslavia and the Republic of Albania (the Western Balkans), \nover the past two decades, including the undermining of post-war agreements \nand institutions following the breakup of the former Socialist Federal Repub-\nlic of Yugoslavia, as well as widespread corruption within various govern-\nments and institutions in the Western Balkans, stymies progress toward \neffective and democratic governance and full integration into transatlantic \ninstitutions, and thereby constitutes an unusual and extraordinary threat \nto the national security and foreign policy of the United States."},{"char_end":10019,"char_start":9726,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 13219, as amended \nby Executive Order 13304, and as expanded by this order, there need be \nno prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to this order."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13219>EO:14033","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 6.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"whole","signing_date":"2021-06-08","target_id":"EO:13219","verb":"transfer"}

EO 13251 (signed 2001-12-28; 67 FR 1599; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13251.txt, read in full) prescribes the order in which officers of the Department of State act as Secretary of State when the Secretary cannot serve, states exceptions, and revokes Executive Order 12343. Identity: the Title 3 heading of Executive Order 13251 of December 28, 2001, on an order of succession within the Department of State at 67 FR 1599, the title and the date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory has thirty-eight clauses, four of which are too short to verify as quotations, so I replaced it with nineteen clauses (inventory override): the authority recital, section 1, the paragraphs of section 2 (with numbered subparagraphs joined to their parent paragraphs and the heading joined to paragraphs (a) and (b)), the paragraphs of section 3 and section 4. Own terms: no clause of sections 1 to 3 has an end date or ending condition; section 4 is a self-executing revocation of EO 12343 performed on issuance and recorded as terminated on 2001-12-28; section 3(b) was replaced by EO 13261. Later instruments: a search of every held order text for the number 13251 finds EO 13261 (replacing section 3(b), attached as a later event), the order's own Federal Register copy and a 2010 Federal Register document whose authority line reads Executive Order 13251 dated November 24, 2009, which is a miscitation of another order and not an instrument affecting this one; no held text revokes or supersedes it. The three selected machine searches (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) were read with their coverage notes, carry no coverage warning, and record 1, 1 and 1 hits for the order number respectively. EO 13251 (signed 2001-12-28; 67 FR 1599; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13251.txt, read in full) prescribes the order in which officers of the Department of State act as Secretary of State when the Secretary cannot serve, states exceptions, and revokes Executive Order 12343. Identity: the Title 3 heading of Executive Order 13251 of December 28, 2001, on an order of succession within the Department of State at 67 FR 1599, the title and the date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory has thirty-eight clauses (the lead-in, sections 1 to 4 and their lettered and numbered paragraphs); I confirmed it without correction. Own terms: no clause of sections 1 to 3 has an end date or ending condition; section 4 is a self-executing revocation of EO 12343 performed on issuance and recorded as terminated on 2001-12-28; section 3(b) was replaced by EO 13261. Later instruments: a search of every held order text for the number 13251 finds EO 13261 (replacing section 3(b), attached as a later event), the order's own Federal Register copy and a 2010 Federal Register document whose authority line reads Executive Order 13251 dated November 24, 2009, which is a miscitation of another order and not an instrument affecting this one; no held text revokes or supersedes it. and\n(b) persons determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation\nwith the Secretary of State,\n(i) to be senior officials of the former Iraqi regime or their immediate\nfamily members; or\n(ii) to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act for\nor on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any of the persons listed in the\nAnnex to this order or determined to be subject to this order."},{"char_end":6821,"char_start":6548,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing\nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 13303 and expanded\nin scope in this order, there need be no prior notice of a listing or determina-\ntion made pursuant to section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":8124,"char_start":7794,"text":"Nothing in this order is intended to affect the continued effectiveness\nof any rules, regulations, orders, licenses, or other forms of administrative\naction issued, taken, or continued in effect heretofore or hereafter under\n31 C.F.R. chapter V, except as expressly terminated, modified, or suspended\nby or pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":8709,"char_start":8672,"text":"This order is effective on 12:01 a.m."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13303>EO:13315@1332365c0477bb25","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. - **ACT:EO:13303>EO:13350#1921-amend**; S89428b523bc883dc51d9e658; {"actor_id":"EO:13350","char_end":2171,"char_start":1921,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2171,"char_start":1921,"text":"I hereby amend Executive Order \n13290 of March 20, 2003, so that the authorities therein remain in effect \nbased on the national emergency I declared in Executive Order 13303 of \nMay 22, 2003, and expanded in Executive Order 13315 of August 28, 2003."},{"char_end":3145,"char_start":2712,"text":"Pursuant to section 202(a) of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622(a)), termi-\nnation of the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12722 shall \nnot affect any action taken or proceeding pending but not finally concluded \nor determined as of the effective date of this order, any action or proceeding \nbased on any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties \nthat matured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."},{"char_end":3588,"char_start":3146,"text":"Pursuant \nto section 207(a) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706(a)), and subject to such regulations, \norders, directives, or licenses as may be issued pursuant to this order, \nI hereby determine that the continuation of prohibitions with regard to \ntransactions involving property blocked pursuant to Executive Orders 12722 \nor 12724 that continues to be blocked as of the effective date of this order \nis necessary on account of claims involving Iraq."},{"char_end":6040,"char_start":5750,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures \nto be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in Executive \nOrder 13303, and expanded by Executive Order 13315, there need be no \nprior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to Executive Order \n13315 or this order."},{"char_end":7625,"char_start":7547,"text":"This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July \n30, 2004."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13303>EO:13350#1921-amend","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date. MULTIPLE_PROVISIONS: located provisions retained separately; all require review.","provision_label":"","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Pursuant to section 202(a) of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622(a)), termi-\nnation of the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12722 shall \nnot affect any action taken or proceeding pending but not finally concluded \nor determined as of the effective date of this order, any action or proceeding \nbased on any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties \nthat matured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2004-07-29","target_id":"EO:13303","verb":"amend"}

declared in Executive Order 12722 shall\nnot affect any action taken or proceeding pending but not finally concluded\nor determined as of the effective date of this order, any action or proceeding\nbased on any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties\nthat matured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date."},{"char_end":2941,"char_start":2505,"text":"Pursuant\nto section 207(a) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706(a)), and subject to such regulations,\norders, directives, or licenses as may be issued pursuant
